title: shorea hopeifolia
intro: Shorea hopeifolia, commonly known as the Hopea tree or Balam, is a species of tree that belongs to the family Dipterocarpaceae. This tree is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Shorea hopeifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which help to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as sedation, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects.
